settings.home_about_heading: Local knowledge. *A good stock.* Friendly service.
settings.home_about_text:
Based on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets in Condobolin, Teqco supplies steel, tools, hardware and much more to farmers, tradies and locals across the district.

Formerly CS Steel, Teqco continues to provide a broad range of products and practical services for jobs on the farm, at work and around the home. Pop in, tell us what you're working on and we'll do our best to point you in the right direction.

home_about_points.a: A wide stock under one roof
home_about_points.b: Steel, tools, fasteners, hardware and everyday essentials for work and around the property.
Friendly service to help you find the right gear for the job.
Your local supplier for rural, trade and home projects.

settings.home_contact_heading: Got a question? Give us a call.
settings.home_contact_text: Product range, sizes or a quote for a cut. Call, drop in, or send an enquiry and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
settings.about_hero_title: Local know-how. The gear to get the job done.
settings.about_hero_text: Your local stop for steel, tools, hardware and rural supplies in Condobolin. Whether you’re working on the farm, on the tools or tackling a job at home, we’re here to help you find what you need.
settings.about_story_heading: A local name for the *jobs that matter*
settings.about_story_text:
Located on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets in Condobolin, Teqco supplies farmers, tradespeople and handymen across the Lachlan Valley with the steel, tools and hardware they need to get the job done.

Previously CS Steel, Teqco continues to supply a wide range of steel sections, sheet metal, mesh, hand and power tools, fasteners and general hardware. With practical advice and friendly service, we’re here to help you find the right gear for the job, big or small.

about_stats.b: Sheet metal cutting and folding in-store

about_services.title: Steel supply
about_services.text: From RHS and SHS to pipe, angle, flat bar, sheet metal, mesh and roofing, we stock a wide stock of steel products for farm, building and workshop projects. Cut-to-length options are available on selected products.

about_services.title: Cutting and folding
about_services.text: Need sheet metal cut or folded to size? We offer in-store guillotine cutting and folding for sheet metal up to 3mm thick. Get in touch to discuss your measurements and requirements.

about_services.title: Tools and hardware
about_services.text: From hand and power tools to fasteners, fittings and everyday hardware, we carry the essentials for the workshop, the job site and around the property.

settings.about_cta_text:
You’ll find us on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets in Condobolin. Pop in, have a chat with the team and pick up what you need for the next job.

Can't make it in? Give us a call or send through an enquiry and we'll be happy to help.
settings.products_hero_title: A whole lot for the job at hand
settings.products_hero_text: From a box of tek screws to a trailer load of RHS, you'll find a good range of supplies for the farm, the workshop and jobs around the home. Browse our ranges below, or give us a call if you're after something in particular.
settings.products_catalogues_text: Browse the full ranges from some of the brands we stock. Catalogues open on the supplier's website.
settings.products_cta_text: If we don't have it on the shelf, we can usually source it. Call us or send an enquiry with sizes and quantities and we will come back with a price.
settings.contact_hero_title: Got a question? Give us a call.
settings.contact_hero_text: Need help with our products, sizes or a quote? Whether you’re planning a job or looking for the right materials, give us a call, drop into the store or send us an enquiry. We’re happy to help.
settings.contact_text: For a quick answer, give us a call or pop into the store. If you need a quote, send through your sizes and quantities using the form below, and we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
settings.contact_map_text: 22 Bathurst Street, on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets.
settings.footer_blurb: Comprehensive retail outlet for the rural, trade and handyman market. Steel, tools, fasteners and hardware in Condobolin.
settings.seo_title: Teqco | Steel, Tools & Hardware Store in Condobolin NSW
settings.seo_description: Teqco is Condobolin’s steel, tools and hardware store. Steel cut to size, roofing and mesh, welding gear, power and hand tools, fasteners, gas, trailers, sheds and more for farm, trade and home.
home_about_paragraphs: Based on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets in Condobolin, Teqco supplies steel, tools, hardware and much more to farmers, tradies and locals across the district.

Formerly CS Steel, Teqco continues to provide a broad range of products and practical services for jobs on the farm, at work and around the home. Pop in, tell us what you're working on and we'll do our best to point you in the right direction.
about_story_paragraphs: Located on the corner of Bathurst and Denison Streets in Condobolin, Teqco supplies farmers, tradespeople and handymen across the Lachlan Valley with the steel, tools and hardware they need to get the job done.

Previously CS Steel, Teqco continues to supply a wide range of steel sections, sheet metal, mesh, hand and power tools, fasteners and general hardware. With practical advice and friendly service, we’re here to help you find the right gear for the job, big or small.

ranges.title: Steel, Roofing, Mesh
ranges.subtitle: Steeline, Lysaght, Arc Metalcentre, Steel Supplies
ranges.description: A good range of steel sections, sheet, mesh and roofing supplies for farm, building and workshop jobs. From RHS and SHS to pipe, angle, flat bar, rod and channel, we stock a variety of common sizes, with cutting to length available on selected products. We also offer sheet metal guillotining and folding up to 3mm thick.

ranges.title: Welding Equipment & Power Tools
ranges.subtitle: Weldclass, HiKoki, Metabo
ranges.description: From welders, wire and rods to grinders, drills, saws and cordless tools, we carry equipment and consumables for the workshop and job site. We also stock welding accessories and protective gear to help you get the job done.

image.alt: Welder at work in a helmet

ranges.title: A-teq Trailers
ranges.subtitle: Built locally. See the A-teq range
ranges.description: Looking for a trailer for work or around the property? Ask us about A-teq box, cage and tandem trailers, including custom options, along with trailer parts and accessories.

ranges.title: Industrial & Domestic Gas
ranges.subtitle: Speed Gas, Origin
ranges.description: Teqco is a local agent for Origin Energy LPG and Speedgas, offering gas bottle exchange for homes, farms, businesses and workshops. Whether you need LPG for the property or welding gases for the job, contact the team to find out about available cylinders and exchange options.

ranges.title: Abrasives & Fasteners
ranges.subtitle: Addler, AllFasteners, Specfast
ranges.description: From cutting and grinding discs to bolts, nuts, washers, tek screws, anchors and rivets, we stock a practical range of workshop and building essentials in a variety of sizes.

ranges.title: Grainline Augers
ranges.subtitle: Grain handling for harvest
ranges.description: Grain augers and spare parts for harvest, including flighting, gearboxes, belts and drive components. Talk to us early in the season so the parts are on the shelf when you need them.

ranges.title: Peerless Air Compressors
ranges.subtitle: Workshop and portable units
ranges.description: Workshop and portable air compressors, from small direct-drive units to belt-drive workshop models, with hoses, fittings, couplers and air tools to suit.

ranges.title: Atlantic Oils & Lubricants
ranges.subtitle: Engine, hydraulic and gear oils
ranges.description: Engine, hydraulic, gear and transmission oils in packs and drums, plus greases, grease guns, coolants and workshop fluids for trucks, tractors and machinery.

image.alt: Grease gun on a timber bench

ranges.title: Sheds
ranges.subtitle: Shedtech
ranges.description: Shedtech kit sheds for the farm, the workshop and the home: machinery sheds, garages, carports and hay sheds. We help you size and quote the shed, then supply the kit and the fixings to put it up.

image.alt: Shedtech machinery and hay sheds on a farm at sunset

ranges.title: Polymaster Tanks
ranges.subtitle: Rainwater and stock tanks
ranges.description: Rainwater tanks, stock water tanks, troughs and chemical tanks in poly, with outlets, fittings, float valves and pump connections.

ranges.title: Garden Edging
ranges.subtitle: Teqedge
ranges.description: Teqedge steel garden edging in a range of profiles, heights and finishes for paths, lawns and garden beds. Straight lengths, curves and corner pieces, with pins and joiners.

ranges.title: Hand Tools
ranges.subtitle: KC Tools, Sheffield Group
ranges.description: Spanners, sockets, pliers, hammers, measuring tools, tool chests and rolls from KC Tools and the Sheffield Group. Trade-quality gear that lasts.

image.alt: Hand tools on the Teqco store wall

ranges.title: Work Safety & Boots
ranges.subtitle: Maxisafe, Beaver
ranges.description: Steel cap and composite toe boots, gloves, hi-vis workwear, eye, ear and respiratory protection, sunscreen and first aid.

ranges.title: Truck & Automotive Supplies
ranges.subtitle: Parts, batteries, accessories
ranges.description: Lights, tie-downs, ratchet straps, tow balls, mudflaps and accessories for trucks, utes and farm vehicles.

image.alt: Road train on an outback highway

ranges.title: General Merchandise
ranges.subtitle: Gate fittings, trailer parts, paint, pumps, chain, matting, castors
ranges.description: Gate fittings from Rotech, trailer parts from Ark, industrial paint, Reefe pumps, chain and cable, rubber matting, wheels and castors from Allied Industrial, Ultragrime wipes and the everyday hardware that keeps a property running.
